data: What is the performance of the ENDE encoder on the POS-based classification accuracy for states when using a different dataset, and how is it presented in the figure?

The performance of the ENDE encoder on the POS-based classification accuracy for states when using a different dataset is presented in Figure 16. The figure shows the accuracy values for each layer across four categories: NOUNS, VERBS, ADJ/ADV, and OTHER. The accuracy values range from approximately 0.890 to 1.000, with higher values indicating better performance. The data is represented by red squares, and the color scale on the right indicates the accuracy levels, ranging from blue (lower accuracy) to red (higher accuracy). The caption provides the exact numerical values for each category and layer, which can be cross-referenced with the figure for a more detailed analysis.
